theme: Adaptive Workstreams — governed memory feeds governed execution: the reserved agent-memory edge enforced (read-only, one path, same-grant by construction, share-gated, per-read chained) + agent-composed per-tick plans that ALWAYS park for informed human review (the proposed Run; consent binds to each tick's reviewed plan). The loop closes: remember -> plan -> govern -> act -> accrue -> remember. Zero model dependency; the platform's agents remain the customer's external MCP clients.

adrs.ADR-0065: Accepted 2026-07-16 (80de0dc) — Adaptive Workstreams: discharges ADR-0064 §Deferred's fused pair (agent-memory enforcement + memory->execution coupling, one trigger, together) and ADR-0063 §Deferred's agent-composed-plans item. Three gateway control-plane tools on the run.launch forward pattern (workstream.poll / plan.submit / memory.read; the gateway stays keyless); the reserved agent-memory edge enforced on the memory-read path ONLY (the set unchanged — ADR-0046 preserved); containment: read-only, readable set derived server-side from the caller's own live grants (cross-grant impossible by construction), accrued reference rows default-readable, authored content share-gated (agent_visible + the audited memory.shared/unshared flip pair), tombstoned rows excluded, every agent-plane read chained fail-loud (no event, no data); the adaptive charter kind (additive; the named composer = the auto-issued grant's grantee); the inbound plan channel (tick opens a TTL-bounded request; the agent polls + submits; expiry audited, never wedges); the plan-preview park (the proposed Run — plan-vs-grant through the shared core, full-plan informed review, approve -> the deferred run.launched, deny -> canceled + run.denied); adaptive plans ALWAYS park at v0.9. Extends ADR-0062/0063/0064; preserves ADR-0046/0056/0060 + ADR-0064's operator plane; edits no Accepted ADR (G2-clean).
